punchline: A man with about ten years of monastic training built his method around ten minutes a day.
thirty_sec: Andy Puddicombe left university in 1994 and trained for about ten years as a Buddhist monk. When he came back to the UK in 2004, he did not turn that into a long ritual. The unit in his book is ten minutes, once a day, called Take10: an upright back, a few deep breaths, and a return to the breath whenever the mind wanders. In 2010 he and Richard Pierson started Headspace in London.
